## Architectures

<a id="pocket-tts"></a>

### Pocket TTS

Continuous autoregressive FlowLM.

[Repository](https://github.com/kyutai-labs/pocket-tts) · [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.06926)

![Pocket TTS — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/pocket-tts.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.06926)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** streaming

Small streaming synthesizer derived from continuous audio language modeling.

**Variants:** 100M.

</details>

<a id="vibevoice"></a>

### VibeVoice

Next-token diffusion over continuous speech latents.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19205)

![VibeVoice — Figure 2](../assets/architectures/vibevoice.png)

*Figure 2 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19205)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** generation

Synthesizes long scripted conversations; ASR is a separate model in the same project.

**Variants:** 1.5B; 7B.

</details>

<a id="voxcpm"></a>

### VoxCPM

Hierarchical semantic/acoustic LM and diffusion.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24650)

![VoxCPM — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/voxcpm.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24650)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** streaming

Tokenizer-free speech generation with voice conditioning.

**Variants:** VoxCPM; VoxCPM1.5.

</details>

<a id="voxcpm2"></a>

### VoxCPM2

Hierarchical diffusion-autoregressive model.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06928) · [Repository](https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM)

![VoxCPM2 — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/voxcpm2.png)

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** streaming
